subject: Wire drains to the selected backend + overlay.config.backend + hard-block + /config/backend endpoint
description:
Builds on the T1 seam (lib/llm-backend.js, getActiveBackend) merged at feature HEAD 15a0a7c. Branch off orch/feature/pluggable-backend. Four coupled pieces:
1. CONFIG: add overlay.config.backend ({provider, model}) read/write in lib/overlay.js, persisted with the rest of overlay.config.
2. ENDPOINT: a GET/POST /config/backend daemon route (new routes/ module + register in daemon.js). GET returns the active backend + listProviders() each annotated with detected isAvailable/isAuthed status (so the dashboard can show per-provider readiness). POST sets overlay.config.backend ({provider, model}) and persists.
3. ROUTE THE DRAINS: in lib/headless-drain.js, replace the hardcoded Claude judge invocation with getActiveBackend(overlay).buildInvocation(...) so the CONFIGURED provider's {bin,args,env} drive the judge drain (the learner/label remain node-script drains; this is the agentic-CLI judge path). For an 'api'-kind active backend, the judge path is not yet implemented (that's the separate API-backend task) — guard it so it skips cleanly rather than calling the throwing stub.
4. HARD-BLOCK: if no valid backend (configured provider not available/authed, or none set and Claude unavailable), runDueDrains no-ops with skipped:'no_backend' — a clean pause + signal, not a crash.
Tests: config read/write; the endpoint GET (provider status) + POST (set); the judge drain routes through getActiveBackend.buildInvocation; hard-block returns no_backend when invalid. SCOPE: NOT the dashboard UI (separate), NOT the real API-provider runJudgeLoop impl (separate — the api stub stays throwing), NOT Codex/Cursor providers (separate). Keep ORCH_HEADLESS_DRAINS default-OFF + the fire-rate backoff intact.

summary: Wired drains to the selectable backend (builds on seam task /14). (1) CONFIG: lib/overlay.js setBackendConfig/getBackendConfig for overlay.config.backend {provider,model} — persists via existing config LOCAL_FIELDS (save/load round-trip); unset = Claude default. (2) ENDPOINT: new routes/config.js (wired into daemon.js routeModules + /config auth gate widened to startsWith) — GET /config/backend returns active backend + listProviders() each annotated isAvailable/isAuthed (isAvailable=null for api kind); POST /config/backend {provider,model?} validates provider id (400 unknown), persists, falsy provider clears to default. (3) DRAIN ROUTING: lib/headless-drain.js judge drain now resolves spawn via getActiveBackend(overlay).buildInvocation(...) (provider-owned {bin,args,env}); buildJudgePrompt extracted; runDrain forwards explicit env when given; learner/label drains unchanged. (4) HARD-BLOCK: resolveJudgeBackend → runDueDrains returns skipped:'no_backend' when no available/authed backend, and skipped:'api_backend_not_implemented' for an api-kind backend (throwing runJudgeLoop stub NEVER called); judge skip is non-fatal (learner/label still run); backoff gate + per-tick cap + flag-off default preserved. Tests: +10 in test/headless-drain.test.js, new test/config-backend.test.js (+10) → node --test both files 67/67 pass; node --check clean on all 6 touched files. NOTE: pre-existing test/endpoints.test.js failure at line 251 (/mark-root) reproduces on the pristine feature base — NOT caused by this task.
